## Unmeasured frontier

The selected POSIX, signal/process, and resolver/network contracts above are not full standards conformance. Static candidate ABI parity, exhaustive header declaration/layout parity, loader runtime-slice results, real Alpine corpus, and stock Rust `std` compatibility are not measured by this dashboard yet. The focused loader stderr-isolation regression is passing, but it is not a verified loader slice.
